tier_1_method_card.score_function: Leave-one-out residuals combined with leave-one-out predictions at the test point.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Rigorous finite-sample predictive coverage under exchangeable training samples for symmetric fitting algorithms; K-fold extension also has coverage guarantees.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Exchangeable training samples; fitting treats training points symmetrically.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Leave-one-out refits; no runtime number in the abstract.

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Foldwise conformal p-values combined with exchangeability- and randomization-aware p-value aggregation.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Abstract reports coverage at least 1−2α−2(1−α)(K−1)/(n+K); a simple variant attains at least 1−2α.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Exchangeability is leveraged across folds; arbitrary dependence is not claimed valid.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: K-fold model fitting plus p-value combination; no numeric runtime reported.

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Quantile-regression interval score based on gaps between observations and fitted lower/upper conditional quantiles.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Finite-sample valid marginal coverage with interval length adapting to heteroscedasticity.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Conformal validity relies on exchangeability of calibration/test data.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Fit two quantile regressors then calibrate residual scores; no runtime reported.

calibration_analysis.isotonic_regression_limits: Not isotonic; CQR addresses varying conditional interval width.

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Weighted conformal quantiles using the likelihood ratio between test and training covariate distributions.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Distribution-free intervals under covariate shift when the likelihood ratio is known or accurately estimated; also weighted exchangeability.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Training/test covariates differ; known/accurately estimated density ratio or weighted exchangeability.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Density-ratio estimation plus weighted conformal quantiles; no runtime reported.

ncaaf_specifics.distribution_shift_type: Covariate shift between training and test covariates.

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Split-conformal residual/nonconformity score on a held-out calibration set.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: For many non-exchangeable processes, concentration/decoupling gives validity with a small coverage penalty; tested on time series and spatiotemporal data.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Non-exchangeable dependence is handled through process-specific concentration and decoupling assumptions.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Reported as extremely simple and orders of magnitude faster than alternatives.

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Monotone loss/nonconformity scores with relevance weights for a test example.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Controls expected value of any monotone loss under non-exchangeability; relevance weights can tighten bounds under drift/change points.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Designed for non-exchangeable data including time series and distribution drift.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Weighted risk-control computation; no numeric cost reported.

calibration_analysis.isotonic_regression_limits: Not addressed; isotonic regression is not the proposed guarantee mechanism.

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Quantile Regression Forest learns the nonconformity-score distribution and supplies test-point-specific weights; groupwise conformalization is also used.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Assumption-free finite-sample marginal and training-conditional coverage; conditional coverage under suitable assumptions.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Marginal/training-conditional claims are assumption-free; conditional coverage needs suitable assumptions.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: QRF plus weighted/groupwise conformal computation; exact runtime not stated.

calibration_analysis.isotonic_regression_limits: Not isotonic; QRF score-distribution adaptation is the calibration device.

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Online conformal errors with a dynamically adjusted significance level at each forecast horizon.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Finite-sample coverage guarantees for each multi-step horizon and overall error rate, including non-exchangeable data.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Online non-exchangeable time-series setting with horizon-specific target errors and learning rates.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Sequential level updates plus forecasting model; no numeric cost reported.

calibration_analysis.isotonic_regression_limits: Not isotonic; dynamic level adaptation is the calibration mechanism.

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Jackknife+-inspired locally rescaled conformity scores using an estimated local score distribution.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Formal global coverage guarantees and local-coverage results including an a posteriori calibration-score bound.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Calibration-test exchangeability is preserved despite using calibration data in rescaled scores.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Jackknife+-style refitting plus local score-distribution estimation; exact cost not stated.

calibration_analysis.isotonic_regression_limits: Not isotonic; local score rescaling targets local coverage.

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Venn/Venn-Abers set-valued predictions from perfectly in-sample calibrated predictors and generic losses.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: At least one marginally calibrated point prediction in finite samples; quantile loss yields group-conditional/multicalibrated conformal intervals.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Finite-sample marginal calibration is central; abstract does not state a simple iid label.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Calibration plus set-valued prediction; no runtime estimate.

calibration_analysis.isotonic_regression_limits: Histogram binning and isotonic regression are described as asymptotic-only; output remains set-valued in finite samples.

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Smooth generalization of pinball-loss quantile scores within additive quantile regression.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Calibrated conditional-quantile inference and reliable quantile uncertainty estimates; not a conformal finite-sample guarantee.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Loss-based Bayesian updating with smoothing priors; no exchangeability guarantee claimed.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Fast stable additive fitting with automatic smoothing/learning-rate selection.

tier_1_method_card.score_function: Conformal prediction inflates the score-quantile level; Wasserstein DRO shifts the quantile value through an ambiguity radius.
tier_1_method_card.coverage_guarantee: Both are described as calibration-conditional coverage with high probability over calibration data; conformal retains distribution-free finite-sample validity under exchangeability.
tier_1_method_card.exchangeability_assumption: Conformal requires exchangeability; DRO depends on ambiguity-radius/distribution properties.
tier_1_method_card.computational_cost: Closed-form conformal level correction versus DRO radius optimization; no runtime benchmark.

input_features.value: Opening and closing Vegas betting lines

tier_2_model_card.output_distribution: Betting-line predictions of divisional winners and against-the-spread outcomes.
tier_2_model_card.calibration_method: Not stated; evaluates accuracy and betting returns rather than post-hoc probability calibration.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: Home teams beat the spread 47%; home-underdog strategy reached 53.5% versus cited 52.38% break-even.
tier_2_model_card.data_requirements: 2,560 post-expansion regular- and post-season NFL games from 2002–2011.

input_features.value: Team-level random effects across multiple game-level responses

tier_2_model_card.output_distribution: Joint normal-binary and Poisson-binary multivariate GLMM distributions.
tier_2_model_card.calibration_method: First-order and fully exponential Laplace approximations; no post-hoc calibration reported.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: Potential cross-response correlation is modeled through team random effects; no specific calibration bias quantified.
tier_2_model_card.data_requirements: Several seasons of American college football and basketball; mvglmmRank R package.

ncaaf_specifics.distribution_shift_type: Cross-sport/team random-effect dependence; no transfer-portal analysis.

tier_2_model_card.calibration_method: Bayesian estimation; no post-hoc calibration method stated.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: Illustrated on one 2021 Big XII championship game; generalization/calibration requires a kill test.
tier_2_model_card.data_requirements: Division-I FBS game-state data sufficient to model remaining possessions and expected score.

ncaaf_specifics.distribution_shift_type: Within-game temporal/state shift; transfer portal not analyzed.

input_features.value: Period-specific attacking and defensive team abilities

tier_2_model_card.output_distribution: Bayesian discrete-time dynamic goal-based models with time-varying attacking/defensive abilities.
tier_2_model_card.calibration_method: Bayesian weighted dynamic modeling with spike-and-slab hyperpriors; no post-hoc calibration reported.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: Static-ability models miss rapid changes; adaptive shrinkage responds to substantial changes.
tier_2_model_card.data_requirements: Last five seasons of German Bundesliga, English Premier League, and Spanish La Liga; footBayes R package.

ncaaf_specifics.distribution_shift_type: Roster/coach regime shift around transfer windows; association football, not NCAAF.

tier_2_model_card.output_distribution: Bayesian state-space model for competitive effect on outcomes/points.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: Bye-week advantage declined after 2011 CBA; since 2011 no significant advantage.
tier_2_model_card.data_requirements: NFL schedule, game-outcome, and betting-market data before/after 2011 CBA.

tier_2_model_card.output_distribution: Conditional density estimates for receiver yards and 2D spatial distribution of baseline ghost defenders.
tier_2_model_card.calibration_method: Random forests for conditional density estimation; no calibration reported.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: Baseline ghost distributions and tracking-data limitations; extension beyond nearest-defender-at-catch remains open.

input_features.value: Motion type identified by Gaussian mixture model

tier_2_model_card.output_distribution: Gamma distribution for play-level snap timing with hierarchical mean and shape parameters.
tier_2_model_card.calibration_method: Bayesian multilevel estimation; no calibration reported.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: Restricted to passing plays with receivers in motion; design choices may bias leaderboard comparisons.
tier_2_model_card.data_requirements: NFL tracking/play-event data for motion and ball-snap timestamps.

input_features.value: Market observations across NFL, NBA, NCAAF, NCAAB, and WNBA

tier_2_model_card.output_distribution: Non-parametric win-probability model for positive-expected-value situations.
tier_2_model_card.calibration_method: No calibration method reported; probability quality needs out-of-sample calibration testing.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: Above-market returns may reflect selection, leakage, or regime dependence; stability is not established in abstract.
tier_2_model_card.data_requirements: Novel betting dataset spanning multiple US sports and markets.

ncaaf_specifics.distribution_shift_type: Sport/league regime shifts across NFL, NBA, NCAAF, NCAAB and WNBA.

tier_2_model_card.output_distribution: Odds-implied bookmaker probability distribution used to select mispriced bets; no parametric output distribution specified.
tier_2_model_card.calibration_method: Odds-implied probabilities and mispricing rules; no formal calibration reported.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: Reported market inefficiency and discriminatory limits against successful clients; profitability needs temporal/out-of-sample validation.
tier_2_model_card.data_requirements: 10-year closing-odds simulation, 6-month minute-to-minute simulation, and 5-month real-money period across thousands of football games.

input_features.value: Moneyline odds for professional and college sports

tier_2_model_card.output_distribution: Moneyline implied-probability/return distribution by sport and odds range.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: NBA market reported unusually inefficient during COVID; underdogs produced 16.7% margin, concentrated in odds 233–400; other sports did not show same inefficiency.
tier_2_model_card.data_requirements: Professional and college sports betting records with COVID-era comparisons.

ncaaf_specifics.distribution_shift_type: COVID-era market regime shift; college sports included but main positive result is NBA.

input_features.value: 23 million moneyline trades across major sport leagues

tier_2_model_card.output_distribution: Calibrated event probabilities and cross-game parlay prices.
tier_2_model_card.calibration_method: Calibration curves fit within time-to-expiry buckets; final-ten-minute curves fit with a Prelec form.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: Calibration is expiry-dependent; final-ten-minute curve is step-like and parlays are overpriced versus contemporaneous leg-price products, increasingly with leg count.
tier_2_model_card.data_requirements: 23 million moneyline trades and cross-game parlay legs from Kalshi across major sports.

calibration_analysis.isotonic_regression_limits: No isotonic regression; reports sharp time-dependent calibration and a Prelec fit.

sgp_parlay_data.correlation_model: Leg-level contemporaneous prices are multiplied as benchmark; observed cross-game parlay prices exceed it.

tier_2_model_card.output_distribution: Profit decomposition: hold, price-shading × public-lean, and bet-share/outcome covariance.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: Pooled bet-share/outcome dependence is a Simpson paradox disappearing when stratified by book-favored side.
tier_2_model_card.data_requirements: Bet-share, price, and outcome data for 1,139 MLB games.

input_features.value: NFL game data from last six seasons

tier_2_model_card.output_distribution: Fantasy-football quarterback score predictions from SVR and neural networks.
tier_2_model_card.known_biases: Limited six-season dataset and model assumptions; abstract calls results promising but needs kill test.
tier_2_model_card.data_requirements: Only game data from last six NFL seasons; paper suggests enhancing data.
